name: FuelCardReconciler
tagline: Every fuel card transaction matched to the truck, the card, the tank and the fuel economy – with a review workflow.
description: A complete fuel-control app for fleets in one Power Apps code component: checks every card transaction for over-tank fills, card / vehicle mismatches, fuel bought away from the vehicle, wrong products, fuel economy anomalies, odometer errors, repeat fills, price outliers, off-hours and daily-limit breaches, then runs the review from investigation and driver explanation to approval within limits, dispute and recovery.
features: 12 reconciliation checks with amount at risk
Fuel economy per fill from odometer distance
Demo mode with a fictional fleet
